_about: Registration of the KEEL adapters in a PROJECT .claude/settings.json (not the global one: global hooks hit every project). Use `python tools/install_hooks.py --project <path>` to write this for you with absolute paths, or copy by hand and replace /ABSOLUTE/PATH/TO/keel with the folder you cloned. Use `python`, not `pythonw`, and always `-S -E`: site packages are not needed by the layer, and processing them costs 67-104 ms on every call (measured on one machine). The `*` matcher for Pre/PostToolUse makes the live ledger and the history ledger measure the same way. PreToolUse is optional (the installer does not register it, to save one process per call).
